speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of alcohol use or liver disease, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or yellowing of your skin? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your age and significant weight loss, have you experienced any changes in bowel habits, such as constipation, diarrhea, or blood in the stool? I would also like to know if you have had any difficulty swallowing or early satiety. REQUEST TEST: Colonoscopy

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal abdominal ultrasound and colonoscopy, we must look higher in the digestive tract. Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing, heartburn, or pain in your upper abdomen after eating? REQUEST TEST: Upper Endoscopy

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your digestive workup is clear, let's look at other systems. Have you experienced any shortness of breath, chronic cough, or chest pain? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: With the GI and pulmonary workups clear, I need to investigate endocrine and systemic causes. Have you noticed excessive thirst, frequent urination, or tremors, and have you felt unusually warm or had palpitations? REQUEST TEST: Thyroid Function Tests, Fasting Glucose, Complete Blood Count
